name: Phone Connect
author: Brett
description: Pairs the Phone Connect companion app (phone-connect@1) with this console and sends it work: open a page, show a notification, show an approval prompt, start / stop / ask the audio-output recorder, say a line or listen once. Pairing is a one-time code from Settings → Plugins → Phone Connect claimed on the phone with your own hub sign-in; the phone then holds a device token you can revoke at any time. Approvals shown on the phone are decided only by your own tap there (personOnly): no session, agent, MCP tool, CLI or voice phrase can approve or deny. New axHub approvals and veto countdowns pop up on the phone with Approve and Deny, console open or not; Follow Amber also brings the console to the front on the phone. Every action is reachable four ways: REST /api/plugins/phone-connect/…, MCP phone_connect_* (plus phone_open_url and phone_status), `axf phone …` and voice (phone.*). Replaces the AmberX app for push, open-url and the recorder.

items.title: Phone Connect status: the paired phone's presence, the link (connected / disconnected: re-pair), the pending pairing code, feature switches, the approvals watcher and the recorder
items.description: Reads Phone Connect in short: whether the paired phone is online, whether its link needs a re-pair, the pairing code still waiting to be claimed, which phone features are switched on, what the approvals watcher last did, and the recorder's last state.

items.title: Everything Settings → Plugins → Phone Connect shows, in one read, with the console-control addresses that open each part
items.description: Reads everything the Phone Connect settings tab shows in one answer (phones, pairing, feature switches, recent commands), with the console-control address that opens each part.

items.title: Every paired, pending or revoked phone with its presence (never its token)
items.description: Lists every phone that is paired, waiting to pair or revoked, with its presence and last contact. Device tokens are never returned.

items.title: One phone by its device id
items.description: Reads one phone by its device id: name, presence, last contact and its own settings. Device tokens are never returned.

items.title: The pending pairing code, if any
items.description: Reads the pairing code that is waiting to be claimed, with its expiry, or nothing when no pairing is pending.

items.title: Issue a pairing code for the Phone Connect app (cancels the pending one); Brett claims it on the phone with his hub sign-in
items.description: Issues a new pairing code for the Phone Connect app and cancels any code still pending. Brett claims it on the phone, signed in to the hub.

items.title: Cancel the pending pairing code
items.description: Cancels the pairing code that is waiting to be claimed, so it can no longer pair a phone.

items.title: Open a page on the phone (https, inside the phone's url policy)
items.description: Asks the paired phone to open an https page, if the phone's url policy allows that address. The answer carries the phone's ack.

items.title: Open an amberxai.com page on the paired phone in Chrome (or the default browser) and bring it to the front
items.description: Opens an https page on one of Brett's own sites (amberxai.com: the console, axHub, the apps) on the paired phone, in Chrome or the default browser, in front. Where Android blocks a start from the background, the phone posts a high-priority notification that opens it with one tap; the answer's `how` says which (direct, notification). Call phone_status first to know whether a phone is there.

url.description: https address on amberxai.com or one of its subdomains, up to 2000 characters

browser.description: chrome (falls back to the default browser when Chrome is not installed) or the phone's default browser

items.output: {ok, opened (true only when the phone says it is on screen), notified (only the tap-to-open notification), how: direct|console-overlay|console-app|notification, why: no-permission|launch-failed, status, id, message}

items.title: Is a phone paired and online, and when did it last check in
items.description: Reads whether a phone is paired with Phone Connect, whether it is online right now, when it last checked in (lastSeenAt, lastSeenAgo) and whether the link needs Brett (link.state: connected, offline, disconnected = re-pair, not-paired). Read this before calling the phone.
items.output: {paired, online, presence, lastSeenAt, lastSeenAgo, device, link: {state, message}, canOpenPages}

items.title: Show a notification on the phone (kind fyi|fix|alert, title, body, url); it asks the Notifications panel first
items.description: Shows a notification on the paired phone (kind fyi, fix or alert, with title, body and an optional link). The Notifications panel's rules are checked first.

items.title: Start the phone's audio-output recorder (needs approvalId: Brett's confirm; the phone asks Android's consent)
items.description: Starts the phone's audio-output recorder. Needs an approvalId from Brett's confirm, and the phone still asks for Android's screen-capture consent.

items.title: Stop the phone's audio-output recorder
items.description: Stops the phone's audio-output recorder and keeps what it recorded.

items.title: The recorder state the phone last reported (ask=1 asks it again)
items.description: Reads the recorder state the phone last reported. With ask=1 the phone is asked for a fresh state first.

items.title: Say a line on the phone (mode say, text) or listen once (mode listen, timeoutSeconds)
items.description: Uses the phone's voice: mode say speaks a line of text, mode listen hears one answer (timeoutSeconds) and returns what was said.

items.title: Queue any phone-connect@1 command (open_url, notify, approval, recorder.*, voice); approval only shows a prompt, it never decides
items.description: Queues any phone-connect@1 command for the phone (open_url, notify, approval, recorder.* or voice). An approval only shows the prompt on the phone; it never decides it.

items.title: Recent commands sent to the phone with their ack and result
items.description: Lists the recent commands sent to the phone, newest first, each with its ack and result.

items.title: One command with its ack and result (wait=<s> holds until it is done)
items.description: Reads one command with its ack and result. With wait=<seconds> the call holds until the phone has finished it or the wait runs out. An open_url command also carries opened: {answered, opened, notified, how, why, message}: opened only when the phone says the page is on screen, notified when it only posted the tap-to-open notification.

items.title: The per-feature switches (open_url, notify, approval, recorder, voice, follow)
items.description: Reads the per-feature switches: which commands the phone accepts (open_url, notify, approval, recorder, voice) and whether Follow Amber also opens on the phone (follow).

items.title: Switch phone features on or off: {features: {open_url|notify|approval|recorder|voice|follow: bool}}
items.description: Switches phone features on or off ({features: {open_url, notify, approval, recorder, voice, follow: true or false}}). A feature that is off refuses its commands; follow off keeps Follow Amber on the console only.
